place.source_title: Eric and Pat Pratt Residence, The Acres (Galesburg Country Homes)

brief: Wright-designed 1951 house in the Acres cooperative: a flat-roofed one-storey wing of light concrete block with a projecting horizontal wood fascia and trellis beams, a tall blank block mass at the entrance and ribbon windows, set under old oaks.

facade.notes: the Pratt residence (Galesburg MI, 1951): a two-storey core of pale concrete block with pierced-block panels, a cantilevered wooden balcony and fascias; under big oaks on a lawn in the woods

why.note: Wright's Usonian house (1936-59): an affordable flat-roofed L on a slab, built of a few materials, turned from the street toward a garden
